# llx

> llx (also installed as lx) is an ultrafast, lightweight coding agent for the terminal.
> It reads and edits files, runs commands, and drives a real browser whose clicks and typing a
> small decision model does. It is one synchronous Rust binary and works with any OpenRouter model.

## Install

- `curl -fsSL https://llx.sh | sh` installs `llx` and `lx` into `~/.local/bin`.
- Sign in with `/login` in a session (`llx`): OpenAI with a ChatGPT sign-in, or OpenRouter with a key. Or set `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`.

## Use

- `llx` opens a session at the terminal; `llx "<task>"` opens one that starts with that task.
- `llx exec "<task>"` (or `llx -p "<task>"`) runs one task and exits: the answer alone on stdout.
- `llx exec --json` prints one JSON event per line; `--schema` ends with data matching a JSON Schema.
- Exit codes: 0 achieved, 1 not achieved, 2 out of turns or time, 3 environment or usage, 130 interrupted.

## Links

- Source and docs: https://github.com/rsaryev/llx
